title: Port Alder forecast card looks
brief: I'm the designer at Port Alder Weather, a small regional forecast app, and we need to choose the look of our forecast card. Please show the same forecast four times, side by side, in four looks that a group can compare on a projector, each labeled with its name and its main colors. The forecast: Port Alder, today high 14 and low 7 degrees, rain chance 60 percent, wind 22 kilometers per hour from the northwest, and highs for the next five days as a small chart in each look: Wed 14, Thu 13, Fri 11, Sat 12, Sun 15. Look 1 is "Clear": white #FFFFFF, navy #12263F text and one blue #2D7DD2 accent, lots of space. Look 2 is "Dense": light gray #ECEFF1, small type, every number visible at once, teal #00796B accent. Look 3 is "Playful": sunny yellow #FFD23F background, rounded shapes, coral #EE6352 accent, larger numbers. Look 4 is "Night": near black #0B1020 with pale text #E6EDF7 and an amber #FFB000 accent. Under each look, list its colors with their hex values. Add a final "Our pick" section, highlighted: the committee favors Clear for phones and Night as the evening option.

edit.request: Change the rain chance to 80 percent in all four looks, and add a fifth look called "Paper": warm white #FAF6EE with brown #5A3E2B text.
